answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the whisper of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
